description: This file defines a class AzureOpenAIFilesAPI that provides methods to interact with Azure OpenAI's file management API, including creating, retrieving, listing, deleting files, and fetching file content. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations and handles client initialization and response processing.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIFilesAPI
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage files with Azure OpenAI within a larger application, supporting both sync and async operations.
